name: Celeborn the Wise
oracle_text:
Whenever you attack with one or more Elves, scry 1.
Whenever you scry, Celeborn gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each card looked at while scrying this way.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you scry, Celeborn gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each card looked at while scrying this way.

needs.what: a trigger event fired when a player scries (controller-filterable, e.g. controller: you), whose event carries the number of cards looked at during that scry as a bindable value, so the effect can be pump on self_only with power and toughness equal to that count until end of turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has surveils and searches_library but no scry event, and value_keys has nothing that reads how many cards a scry looked at; pumping a flat +1/+1 per trigger would be wrong for any scry N greater than 1 (e.g. from other cards)
